items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Manuel Sales will be able to tell you that now, because he shouldn't. You just get to balance that from him.

ctx.x: Who was the woman that played the piano?

I'm trying to think of her name. She used to play piano at, she was an organist at St. Catharines Church. She'd come from back in town, but she was a good old piano player, she could read music too. Now Manuel Sales will be able to tell you that now, because he shouldn't. You just get to balance that from him. I just can't memorize it, so you've been so long.
Well we can ask you about something else. Well what about those women, those hustling women, did many of them sing?
